scheme.defaultMessage: {mode, select, dark {Switch to dark mode} other {Switch to light mode}}
scheme.description: The accessible name of the color scheme toggle. `mode` is the scheme it switches to.

open.description: The accessible name of the button that opens the list of themes.

settings.description: The accessible name of the button that opens the appearance settings (color scheme, contrast, text size and the like), and of the panel it opens.

themes.description: The accessible name of the list of themes.

search.description: The placeholder of the field that filters the list of themes.
